extracted.intended_audience: USPTO examiners, patent attorneys/agents, and patent practitioners involved in reexamination proceedings
extracted.subtask_description: Procedural requirements for how an ex parte reexamination certificate is distributed and made part of patent records after issuance. Covers electronic association with patent files, inclusion in subsequent patent copies, and external dissemination to libraries and foreign offices.

rubrics_metrics.name: E-copy association with patent search files
rubrics_metrics.description: An e-copy of the reexamination certificate will be associated with the e-copy of the patent in the search files.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure the electronic reexamination certificate is linked to the patent's electronic record in the USPTO search files so that the certificate is discoverable with the patent document.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inclusion of certificate in subsequent patent copies
rubrics_metrics.description: A copy of the certificate will also be made a part of any patent copies prepared by the Office subsequent to the issuance of the certificate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When preparing or issuing any paper or electronic copies of the patent after the certificate issues, include the reexamination certificate as part of those copies to reflect the updated patent status.

rubrics_metrics.name: Forwarding certificate to depository libraries and foreign offices
rubrics_metrics.description: A copy of the certificate will also be forwarded to all depository libraries and to those foreign offices which have an exchange agreement with the U.S. Patent and Trademark Office.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Disseminate the reexamination certificate to the government depository libraries and to foreign patent offices that maintain exchange agreements with the USPTO to ensure international and public record updates.
